title: Our Stairs Grow One Step At NIGHT 🪜
description:
Our stairs have ten steps. After dark you'll count eleven, and at two in the morning they creak ten times with nobody on them.

My dad has one house rule. Everyone's upstairs by ten, and nobody touches the stairs after. So one night I sat at the top with a flashlight to see which step was new.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
